title: Zeroth comparison for restricted derived section pullback
statement: Let $S,Y,Y'$ be schemes, $a:Y'\to Y$, $h:Y\to S$, $h':Y'\to S$, $a\gg h=h'$, and $U\to S$ etale. Put $V=U\times_S Y$, $V'=U\times_S Y'$, $q=U\times_S a$, and let $r,r'$ be the projections. Let $G,G'$ be abelian etale sheaves, with $\psi:a^*G\to G'$. Use inverse image and its composition comparisons [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], [lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-composition]. Write $T_h=H^0R\Gamma(V,r^*(-))$, and let $z_{h,G}:T_h(G[0])\cong\Gamma(V,r^*G)$ be the explicit zero comparison [def-sbc-raw-restricted-cohomology-comparison-map]. Define a natural transformation $\tau:T_h\to D^+(a^*)\,T_{h'}$ explicitly: apply $R\Gamma(V,-)$ to the derived adjunction unit for $q$ [prop-weil-pbc-derived-inverse-image-adjunction], use the Leray comparison $Rq_*\,R\Gamma(V,-)\cong R\Gamma(V',-)$, then the derived image of $q^*r^*\cong r'^*a^*$, and take $H^0$. If $c_G:D^+(a^*)(G[0])\cong (a^*G)[0]$ is the single comparison and $\psi_{\mathrm{res}}:q^*r^*G\to r'^*G'$ is the restricted coefficient map [def-sbc-raw-affine-restricted-cohomology], then $\tau_{G[0]}\gg T_{h'}(c_G.\mathrm{hom}\gg\psi[0])=z_{h,G}.\mathrm{hom}\gg q^*_{\Gamma}\gg\Gamma(\psi_{\mathrm{res}})\gg z_{h',G'}.\mathrm{inv}$, where $q^*_{\Gamma}$ is the ordinary section pullback by the adjunction unit. No isomorphism hypothesis is imposed on $\psi$.

source.place: Cohomology on Sites, lemma-adjoint (07A6); lemma-unbounded-cohomology-of-open (0D6F); specialization of the parent derived-section square proof to its zero comparison.

proof.text: Construct the derived restriction comparison from the pullback identity r\prime followed by a equals q followed by r, the upperStarComp isomorphisms and mapDerivedCategoryCompIso. Construct tau from the derived adjunction unit for q followed by the Leray comparison and this restriction comparison. All its data are explicit.

Postcompose the goal with the target zeroIso hom and cancel its inverse. Expand restrictedSectionPullback and map_comp. Apply [lem-sbc-derived-restriction-zero-transport] to the restriction/coefficient/zero-comparison tail. Reassociate and apply [lem-sbc-derived-section-pullback-zero] to the remaining derived pullback/single/zero-comparison prefix. Associativity gives the desired ordinary section pullback followed by the coefficient map.

theorem restrictedSectionPullback_zero {S Y Y' : Scheme.{v}}
    (a : Y' ⟶ Y) (h : Y ⟶ S) (h' : Y' ⟶ S) (w : a ≫ h = h')
    (G : Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1})
    (G' : Sheaf Y'.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1})
    (ψ : (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} a).obj G ⟶ G') (U : S.Etale) :
    (restrictedSectionPullback a h h' w U).app
        ((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).obj G) ≫
      (sectionsFunctor ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ h').obj U) ⋙
        DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} 0).map
          (((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} a).mapDerivedCategoryPlusSingleFunctor 0).hom.app G ≫
            (DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).map ψ) =
      (zeroIso ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ h).obj U) G).hom ≫
        globalSectionsUpperStarMap AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} (rawAffineRestrictedMap a h h' w U)
          ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} (Limits.pullback.snd U.hom h)).obj G) ≫
        (Sheaf.Γ (Limits.pullback U.hom h').smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}).map
          (rawAffineRestrictedCoefficient a h h' w G G' ψ U) ≫
        (zeroIso ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ h').obj U) G').inv
